data.name: Project L33T: Founders Edition
data.detailed_description:
PROJECT L33T: FOUNDERS EDITION

As a private contractor and member of the elite L.3.3.T. team, you will deploy into a persistent open world set in the fictional region of Ozersk — a hostile Zone filled with valuable artifacts, equipment, intelligence, and other players hunting for the same prize. 

Every expedition is a gamble. Bring your gear, push deeper, secure what you can, and extract alive to the safe zone. Die in the Zone, and everything you carried is gone. Return to the same server, fight your way back, and you may still recover what you lost — unless someone else gets there first.

Purchase of the Project L33T Founders Edition gives you the following perks:

  • Ghost Edition of the full game. 

  • Early Access to public and test servers of the game.



PLAY PVE OR PVP SERVER - YOUR CHOICE

Your path is yours to choose. Deploy solo or squad up with other players, then enter either PvE or PvP. Each mode has its own unique character and progression.

PERSISTENT OPEN WORLD 

Game offers a persistent open-world environment where everything you need to survive and prosper can be found in the world — from gear and weapons to consumables such as food and medicine.

Unlike session-based extraction shooters, the best items are not simply waiting for you at traders in the safe zone. To find the most valuable gear, you will need to explore, take risks, and loot deep inside the Zone.

When you exit the game, your expedition does not simply reset. The next time you launch the game, you will return to the world near the point where you left off. To get back to the safe zone, social hub, or your hideout, you will need to locate an extraction area on the map and make it out alive.

SAFE ZONE & PERSONAL HIDEOUT

This is your safe zone — a shared social space where you can meet other players, trade, prepare for your next expedition, and return after surviving the OZERSK Zone.

It also includes your personal hideout, a private space you will need to progress. Upgrade crafting stations, unlock new functionality, and improve your character over time.

Some hideout upgrades unlock new skills, enhance existing abilities, or improve your character’s stats, giving you more ways to survive, fight, craft, and prosper in the world of OZERSK.

 

GEAR UP

Indulge in a comprehensive and versatile character customization system that allows you to tailor your character's appearance to your liking. From hairstyles and skin shades to tattoos and face paints, along with a diverse selection of individual clothing and gear elements, you can ensure your character looks their best for any mission.

Personalize your tactical vests and plate carriers by adding vanity patches. Just like in real life, carefully insert armor plates into your carrier, which can be fully replaced with spares after intense firefights.

GUNSMITH

Prepare to experience the realistic handling of each weapon, including concepts like jamming, overheating, wear and tear, reloading, aiming, charging, and of course, shooting. And do not forget real-life ballistics and projectile hit physics.

Explore one of the most advanced weapons modding systems to date. Customize every crucial component of your firearm, from charging handles to trigger groups to handguards and buttstocks and barrels, down to the finest details.

Additionally, we've introduced the ability to custom-paint any part of your weapon with various patterns and colors. Moreover, you now have the flexibility to position attachments anywhere along rails, allowing for greater freedom and customization.

TEAM UP

Never fight alone! Team up with your friends and create a squad, ensuring you never venture into expeditions solo.
We understand the challenge faced by many survival shooters – without friends to play with, facing other players grouped together can be daunting.

To address this, we've invested significant effort in implementing "Mercs for Hire" – AI teammates available for recruitment. These AI companions behave realistically, following your orders and providing support. Not only will they assist you against other players, but they also enhance your experience, catering to those who prefer a single-player PvE-focused approach in PvEvP shooters.

ENGAGE

Experience your character's RPG-like health and physical characteristics, including hydration, energy levels, blood loss, fractures, contusions, intoxication, exhaustion, tremors, and more.

Take full control of your character with smooth speed and stance changes, as well as fluid transitions between movements like leaning and proning. Vault and climb over obstacles and use ropes to climb tall buildings, use help of other players to conquer higher barriers. Execute various tactical maneuvers such as sliding while shooting.

Discover training manuals scattered throughout the world to learn new skills and master the art of takedowns.

LOOT

Each expedition is unique. Explore a dynamic game map where loot continually spawns in new locations and buildings have varying layouts for apartments.

Photosensitivity Warning

The Project L33T contains strobing and flashing lights that could cause a small percentage of people to experience seizures when exposed to certain lights, patterns, or images.

data.short_description: Join the persistent open world of OZERSK! Choose your way to play on PvE or PvP servers, fight for precious loot and gear, and risk it all in a hostile environment. Die, lose all your gear and loot, then return to the same server in hopes of retrieving what you lost. This is your story!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5, AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia gtx 1070 8gb VRAM or similar AMD card
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 35 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows compatible Audio
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i7, AMD Ryzen 7
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 3080 12gb VRAM or AMD Equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows compatible 3D Spatial audio system
